newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stay supported on cargo prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stay supported on cargo prices.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Tuesday were steady supported by strong cargo prices.
Majors were offering 180-cst at $128 per tonne and 380-cst at $124 per tonne. They said prices remained firm as they perceived cargo prices to be firmer.
Independent traders were quoting around $126 for cst-180 and $120 for cst-380.
Some shipowners were seen covering their requirements from South Korea instead of Singapore.
MDO prices were quoted between $210 and $220 and gas oil steady at $225-$235. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
